## Description
Please include a summary of the new skill or bug fix. 

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New skill (adds a new native or MCP skill)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist for New Skills:
- [ ] I have followed the mandatory 6-section Markdown template (Agent Persona, Core Directives, Input Requirements, Algorithmic Execution, Anti-Patterns, Expected Output).
- [ ] The skill is scoped to Staff/Principal level engineering/product execution.
- [ ] My skill name is lowercase, kebab-case (e.g., `my-new-skill.md`).
- [ ] I have updated the appropriate README.md table.
